sources.note: Main Altera Digital Health homepage. Mentions Sunrise, Paragon, CareInTelligence data platform, Sunrise Thread AI ambient scribe launch. References HIMSS26 presence and partnership with Microsoft Azure.
Product portfolio page listing Sunrise, Paragon, TouchWorks, dbMotion, Care Director, CareFX, Ventus, and Altera Context. Key descriptions of each product's role and target market.
Sunrise product page. Describes cloud-capable features on Microsoft Azure, single patient record across acute/ambulatory/financial. Limited specific detail beyond marketing messaging.
About page with company mission and values. Describes Altera as focused on operational excellence and clinician-first design. No specific customer counts or market data.

November 2025 press release announcing Sunrise Thread AI ambient scribe. Details real-time conversation capture, structured note generation, and governance tools. Confirms Altera HQ in Niagara Falls, NY.
Sunrise 25.1 feature highlights page. Mentions messaging, SuperBill improvements, navigation updates, schedule streamlining, and patient tracking enhancements.
Sunrise Ambulatory Care 25.1 PDF brochure. Binary PDF content, could not extract text directly.
ONC regulatory compliance page. Very sparse content — just a contact form with no product-specific compliance information visible.

About page for Providers Management Inc./Integrated Providers (listed as developer in CHPL metadata). Shows separate ONC-certified patient portal product that uses Altera TouchWorks EHR. Burton, MI based healthcare management organization — appears unrelated to Sunrise development.

EHR in Practice profile. Describes Sunrise as built for large clinical enterprises, mentions decision support, medication management, radiology module, pharmacy integration. Lists specialties (community health, family medicine, surgery, urgent care) and practice sizes (11-50+ physicians). Notes Windows-based with iOS app, cloud or on-premise deployment.
G2 reviews page for Sunrise. 3.2/5 rating from 19 reviews. Mixed feedback — workflow tools and modular approach praised, some UI improvement needs noted. Referenced via web search.

KLAS Research Sunrise review page. Indicates moderate market presence below market leaders. Sufficient survey volume from hospitals but not top-tier performance vs. Epic/Cerner. Referenced via web search.
July 2023 press release about Black Book Research rankings. Sunrise ranked #1 inpatient EHR for community hospitals (101-250 beds) and top EHR for acute rehabilitation hospitals.
May 2022 press release confirming Harris Computer's acquisition of Allscripts' Hospitals and Large Physician Practices segment and rebranding to Altera Digital Health.
Constellation Software press release about the acquisition. Deal valued at up to $700M ($670M at close plus contingent consideration).
Digital Health article confirming rebranding from Allscripts to Altera Digital Health in May 2022.
Health Leaders article on Altera's vision. Notes Harris/Constellation Software's 'buy and hold forever' philosophy providing long-term stability for products and clients.
Client story about Sunrise Financial Manager. Confirms consolidated billing hub, automated work queues, and integrated clinical-financial workflow. Referenced via web search.
Software Finder profile for Sunrise Ambulatory Care. Describes CDS tools, CPOE, analytics capabilities. Referenced via web search.
Sunrise Air iOS app listing on Apple App Store. Confirms native mobile app for clinician access to patient data on the go.
